pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D. 7629
Special Branch - Situation,
REPORT
Date November 25, 1936.

Subject Arrival in Shanghai of Dr. H.B. GUHL, representative of the
Berlin "Eildienst."

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [Signature]

Arriving in Shanghai on November 17, 1936 from the
United States by the "Chichibu Maru" was a Dr. H.B. GUHL.
This gentleman, a German, has come to China as repre-
sentative of the Berlin "Eildienst," an official organ of the
German Ministry of Finance, by which it is subsidised. The
paper is non-political in character and deals entirely with
affairs of an economic nature in order that German trade and
manufacturing concerns may be au fait with matters affecting
their types of business in foreign countries. "Eildienst"
is not a newspaper in the accepted sense of the word, since
it contains nothing but economic news and is never placed on
sale, but distributed gratis to those German centres dealing
in foreign commerce, or those centres interested in such.
Dr. Guhl, who has served in a similar capacity in the
United Kingdom and the United States for a number of years,
is at present residing at 1411 Broadway Mansions. In add-
ition to the above duties as representative of the "Eildienst"
it is said that he will also undertake the task of acting as
a medium in arranging credits for German firms dealing in
China.
A copy of "Eildienst," which means "Express-Service"
is attached herewith. A glance at this publication will
immediately indicate the type of work which it undertakes.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).
（印：K.B. 23 NOV 1936 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 D. 7629
特务科 - 局势，
报告
日期 1936年11月25日。

主题：柏林“Eildienst”代表 H.B. GUHL 博士抵达上海。

制作人 D.S. Pitts。转发人 [签名]

H.B. GUHL 博士于1936年11月17日乘“秩父丸”号（Chichibu Maru）从美国抵达上海。这位德国绅士作为柏林“Eildienst”的代表来到中国，“Eildienst”是德国财政部下属的一个官方机构，并由该部提供补贴。该刊物性质非政治性，完全涉及经济事务，旨在使德国的贸易和制造企业熟悉影响其在国外业务类型的事项。“Eildienst”并非通常意义上的报纸，因为它仅包含经济新闻，且从不公开出售，而是免费分发给那些从事对外贸易或对此感兴趣的德国中心机构。Guhl 博士此前曾在英国和美国担任类似职务多年，目前居住于百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）1411室。据称，除了上述作为“Eildienst”代表的职责外，他还将承担为在华经营的德国公司安排信贷的中介任务。
随函附上“Eildienst”（意为“快速服务”）副本一份。浏览该出版物即可立即了解其所从事的工作类型。

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.

副督察（特务科）。
（印：K.B. 1936年11月23日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
